solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Governor's role since retiring

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so the pair of words is read from the end to the start

parts.note: a role or part in a play
as can mean since, as in 'as you're here'

explanation.surface: A governor's job description has changed since he stepped down from office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retiring' turns the whole run PARTAS round. A satrap was a provincial governor in ancient Persia.
explanation.definitionFit: A satrap was the provincial ruler appointed by a Persian king, hence a governor.

clue.text: Appropriate to become qualified

parts.note: to become someone is to suit them, as a hat becomes its wearer
qualified to do something means able to do it

explanation.surface: Advice that it is fitting to get one's qualifications.
explanation.definitionFit: Something suitable is fitting or right for the purpose, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Retell it differently to include Ophelia's tip for Hamlet perhaps

indicators.note: to include means the shuffled letters take in the extra letter among them
doing it differently means the letters of the two words are arranged another way
the tip of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A director tells the story of Hamlet anew, giving Ophelia a bigger part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'differently' and 'to include' are the indicators; Ophelia is a character in the play, which makes the surface feel like stage direction.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet is the part named in the play's own title, an example of the main character of that kind.

clue.text: Dry run held by assistant is cut short

indicators.note: held by means the letter sits inside the shortened word
cut short means the last letter of the word is lopped off

parts.note: an aide is an assistant
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A rehearsal supervised by a helper is ended early.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut short' takes the E from AIDE, leaving AID; 'held by' puts R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Arid land is parched and dry, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Rival crosses line to finish

indicators.note: crosses here means the word goes across and over the letter, holding it within

parts.note: to rival someone is to compete with them

explanation.surface: An opponent in a race gets over the line to end it.
explanation.definitionFit: To complete a task is to finish it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: A job opportunity in Gap

definitions.meaning: a vacancy for work, as in 'there is an ... in sales'

explanation.surface: A vacancy has come up at a clothing shop.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a vacancy for a job, and a space or gap through which one can pass.

clue.text: Appropriate one in order to implicate old James for instance

parts.note: proper means appropriate or fitting

indicators.note: to implicate is to involve or enfold, so one word wraps around the letter

parts.note: a nun is a member of a religious order

explanation.surface: It seems fitting for a monk to incriminate an old man called James.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to implicate' puts O inside NUN to give NOUN.
explanation.definitionFit: James is a personal name, an example of a word naming one particular thing and written with a capital.

clue.text: Fellow brought up niece's heart bypass

indicators.note: in a down clue brought up means the word reads from the bottom upwards

parts.note: Dave is a generic name for a man, a fellow

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letter

explanation.surface: A man raised his niece, who needed heart surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' turns DAVE into EVAD; 'heart' takes E, the middle letter of NIECE.
explanation.definitionFit: To evade something is to get around it, just as one may bypass a rule.

clue.text: A thing made from tin yet to be modified

indicators.note: to be modified means the letters of the two words are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: Something built from tin that still needs some alterations.
explanation.definitionFit: An entity is anything that exists in its own right, a thing.

clue.text: Deplore uninspiring books

parts.note: lame means weak and unconvincing, so uninspiring
NT is the New Testament, a collection of books

explanation.surface: A critic laments the dull reading on offer.
explanation.definitionFit: To lament something is to express regret or sorrow over it, to deplore it.

clue.text: Reorganisation of it certain to be very complicated

indicators.note: a reorganisation puts the letters of the following words into a different order

explanation.surface: A restructuring is sure to be very complex.
explanation.definitionFit: Intricate means full of detailed, interwoven parts, so very complicated.

clue.text: It may give the impression of movement from the top of one side

definitions.text: It may give the impression of movement

indicators.note: in an across clue the top of a word is taken as its first letter

parts.note: to take someone's part is to take their side

explanation.surface: A rough idea of motion is visible from one side's peak.
explanation.walkthrough: Op art is a 1960s style of abstract painting whose patterns seem to shimmer or move.
explanation.definitionFit: Op art uses optical illusion so that a flat canvas appears to shift and swirl.

clue.text: Murder victim found in lake near Lincoln

indicators.note: near means the letter is placed right next to the name, after it

parts.note: Abe Lincoln, the US president

explanation.surface: A body is discovered by a lake close to Lincoln.
explanation.walkthrough: Abel, son of Adam and Eve, was killed by his brother Cain in the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Abel was slain by Cain in Genesis, the first murder victim in the Bible.

clue.text: Polish soldiers face striking workers at the end of August

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a body of British army soldiers
fine-looking means striking or handsome
men can mean workers, as in management and men

indicators.note: at the end of means the last letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Polish troops confront striking employees in late summer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' looks like the nationality but is the noun meaning elegance; 'face' simply links the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Polish in the sense of cultivated elegance of manner is refinement.

clue.text: Aside from the main issue of security

explanation.surface: A side matter concerning safety.
explanation.definitionFit: Collateral means secondary or incidental, and is also property pledged as security for a loan.

clue.text: Seem to be exhausted causing concern

parts.note: to look tired is to seem tired
out means used up, as when supplies are out

explanation.surface: Looking tired is a cause for worry.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition uses the idiom 'that's your lookout', meaning that's your concern.
explanation.definitionFit: In the idiom 'that's your own lookout' the word means a matter for which one is responsible.

clue.text: Look for girl returning in the middle of Zagreb

indicators.note: in means the reversed name goes inside the two central letters
the middle of a six-letter word is its two central letters
returning means the name is read backwards

parts.note: Edna is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Searching for a girl coming back through central Zagreb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' and 'in' are the indicators. A gander is British slang for a look, as in 'have a gander'.
explanation.definitionFit: Take a gander is informal British for take a look, so the word is a noun for a glance.

clue.text: Earl getting unexpected note becomes disaffected

parts.note: strange means odd or unexpected
D is a note of the musical scale

explanation.surface: A nobleman receiving an odd letter grows alienated.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone estranged has become alienated or disaffected from those once close.

clue.text: A revolutionary gathering support is seized

indicators.note: gathering means taking in, so one word is held inside the other

parts.note: a red is a communist revolutionary
a rest is a support, as for a snooker cue

explanation.surface: A rebel picking up backing is taken into custody.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gathering' is the container indicator; 'is' merely links wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To be arrested is to be seized by the police, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Put right in front to cover both sides of lane

indicators.note: to cover means the word goes around the two letters, enclosing them

parts.note: the head is the front, as at the head of a queue

indicators.note: both sides of means the first and last letters

explanation.surface: Advice to straighten out by moving ahead to block a road from either edge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'both sides of' gives L and E from LANE; 'to cover' puts them inside HEAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Healed means cured or made whole again, so put right.

clue.text: Assaulted president almost gets killed

parts.note: done, as in done over, means beaten up

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the name is dropped

parts.note: Gerald Ford was a US president

explanation.surface: A president under attack is nearly assassinated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the D from FORD. Done over is British slang for beaten up.
explanation.definitionFit: Done for is an idiom for doomed or finished, as good as dead.

clue.text: Opposing a return attack

definitions.meaning: contrary, as in ... to someone's wishes
a blow made in reply, a counterattack or riposte

explanation.surface: Resisting means hitting back.
explanation.definitionFit: Counter means contrary or opposed, and also a retaliatory move made in response.

clue.text: Hoax by daughter managed to get Bill upset

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means the run is turned over and read from the bottom up

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it
AC is an abbreviation for account, a bill

explanation.surface: A daughter's prank succeeded in annoying Bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns the whole run DRANAC round.
explanation.definitionFit: A canard is a false report or rumour, a hoax.

clue.text: Complete run within a shorter distance

parts.note: to close a deal is to complete it
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A full lap run over a shorter course.
explanation.definitionFit: Closer means nearer, at less distance than something else.

clue.text: Officer's story has you speaking to social worker after bag is returned

indicators.note: after means the insect is placed behind the turned word

parts.note: a lie is a made-up story

indicators.note: speaking means the word is said rather than written, giving its sound

parts.note: the word you sounds like the letter U

indicators.note: is returned means the word is read backwards

parts.note: to net a fish is to bag it, and a net is a bag
an ant is a social insect and a worker

explanation.surface: An officer tells you a tale while talking to a social worker after his bag comes back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'speaking', 'is returned' and 'after' are the indicators; an ant is a social insect, so the social worker is no case officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A lieutenant is a junior commissioned officer in the army or navy.

clue.text: Part maintaining setter is correct

indicators.note: maintaining means holding, so one word keeps the other inside

parts.note: an end can be a part, as in one's end of a bargain
the setter of a crossword refers to himself as me

explanation.surface: A role kept by the compiler is accurate.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend a text is to correct its errors, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Rooney reportedly in decline

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so the word goes by its sound

parts.note: Wayne Rooney, the English footballer

explanation.surface: Wayne Rooney's form is said to be slipping.
explanation.walkthrough: Wayne Rooney is a famous former England and Manchester United footballer.
explanation.definitionFit: To wane is to diminish or decline, like the moon after full.

clue.text: Ruler turns up among Laura's things

indicators.note: in a down clue turns up means the letters read from the bottom upwards
among means the letters are found within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A measuring stick appears among Laura's possessions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'among' picks RAST from lauRAS Things; 'turns up' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tsar was the emperor of Russia, an autocratic ruler.

clue.text: Very thin cut on the tongue

indicators.note: on the tongue means as spoken, so the word is judged by its sound

parts.note: to shear is to cut, as with wool

explanation.surface: A fine slice made on the tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheer fabric is so fine and thin as to be nearly transparent.

clue.text: Forget his playing around with Prudence

indicators.note: playing around means the letters are messed about into a new order

explanation.surface: Forget his messing around with a girl called Prudence.
explanation.definitionFit: Foresight is care in planning for the future, a kind of prudence.

clue.text: About to walk back around west end of loch in a state of readiness

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: around means the turned word wraps the letter
back means the word is read in reverse

parts.note: to tread is to walk

indicators.note: in an across clue the west end of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Walking back round the far end of a Scottish lake while on standby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns TREAD into DAERT; 'around' puts L, the west end of loch, inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Red alert is the highest level of alarm, a state of full readiness for danger.

clue.text: Even pieces of gold break before diamond gets worn away

indicators.note: break means the word is split open to take the letters inside

parts.note: ere is a poetic word for before

indicators.note: even pieces are the letters in the second and fourth places

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for diamonds in card games

explanation.surface: Golden fragments shatter and a diamond is worn down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Even pieces of' gives OD from gOlD; it breaks into ERE, then D is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Eroded means gradually worn away, as rock by wind or water.
